'''Gelss''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Some [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the conclusion of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Fekk served under smuggler [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jet Nebula]] in Nebula's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Auriga Fire]]''. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Gelss and another Sullustan, [[Fekk]], became affiliated with Nebula's [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]], [[Shinqo]]. Shinqo planned a mutiny against Nebula and executed it when the ''Auriga Fire'' intercepted the ''[[Cinzia]]''. Holding Nebula at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], Shinqo urged the Captain to contact the ''Cinzia'', and Nebula revealed to the ''Cinzia''{{'s}} crew that they planned to board the ship. Shinqo ordered Gelss and Fekk to prepare for action, but the ''Cinzia'' [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]]. Taking advantage of the confusion, Nebula's [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[Clunker]], grabbed Shinqo and took his blaster, pointing it at the mutineer. With the ''Auriga Fire'' back under Nebula's control, the mutineers accepted their positions under Nebula and the crew picked up some debris from the ''Cinzia''{{'s}} wreckage&mdash;a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomp]] and a [[Fastbreeder|hex droid]] nest.
